reference.description: Body reference used for normalisation (torso length).
reference.title: Reference

wrist_movement.description: Mean wrist speed relative to the torso, per side; unit field included.
wrist_movement.title: Wrist Movement

torso_displacement.description: Net torso-center displacement over the window, normalised.
torso_displacement.title: Torso Displacement

torso_movement.description: Mean torso-center speed along its path over the window (walking back and forth does not cancel out), torso lengths per second.
torso_movement.title: Torso Movement

joint_angles_deg.description: Angles only where all three joints are valid; plane given.
joint_angles_deg.title: Joint Angles Deg

posture.description: Posture measures, medians over `window_s` (null = unavailable), in torso lengths unless noted: arms_cross (both wrists past the body midline; > 0 = crossed), arms_in_zone, wrist_cross/wrist_height per side (height 0 = shoulder line, 1 = hip line), face_touch_distance (nearest wrist to a face point), head_pitch (nose below the ear line, or below the shoulder line without ears; head_pitch_source), head_pitch_reference (head-up percentile over a longer window) and head_pitch_delta; head_roll (degrees: eye or ear line against the shoulder line), head_roll_reference (the person's usual roll, median over a longer window) and head_roll_delta; per side hand_in_pocket, hand_pocket_distance (wrist to its own hip, shoulder widths) and elbow_angle (degrees); hands_in_pockets_count (hands likely in a pocket) and hands_in_pockets. arms_crossed/face_touch/looking_down = measure past its rule threshold; head_tilt = head_roll_delta past pose.head_tilt_min_deg (head_tilt and hands_in_pockets have no coaching rule: episodes only).
posture.title: Posture

note.default: Movement observations only; they do not indicate emotional state.
note.title: Note
